rem Counting Capacitor Circuits
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=155
rem Count the distinct capacitances of
rem circuits of up to Count equal
rem capacitors

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg Count integer = 18

rem A value p / q is stored as the key
rem p K + q. Level m holds the circuits
rem of m capacitors. Joining a level
rem pair in parallel gives half of it,
rem and the series joins are the
rem reciprocals of those values.
rem Equal levels need each unordered
rem pair only once. Complete Rec before
rem unique so both concat inputs have
rem ready compact integer storage.
K = 8192
Store = array 8193
Off = array 0 0 1
for M in 2 to Count
  Pairs = 0
  for I in 1 to M // 2
    Lo = Off (I + 1) - Off I
    Hi = Off (M - I + 1) - Off (M - I)
    if I equal M - I
      Pairs += Lo * (Lo + 1) // 2
    else
      Pairs += Lo * Hi
    end
  end
  Out = array shape Pairs fill 0
  Used = 0
  for I in 1 to M // 2
    J = M - I
    for P in Off I to Off (I + 1) - 1
      A = Store P // K
      B = Store P mod K
      First = Off J
      if I equal J
        First = P
      end
      for Q in First to Off (J + 1) - 1
        C = Store Q // K
        D = Store Q mod K
        Num = A * D + B * C
        Den = B * D
        G = Num gcd Den
        Key = Num // G * K + Den // G
        Out Used = Key
        Used += 1
      end
    end
  end
  Par = Out unique
  Rec = Par mod K * K + Par // K
  Lev' = concat Par Rec unique
  Store = concat Store Lev copy
  End = array (Store len)
  Off = concat Off End copy
end
Answer = Store unique len
Answer print
